description: Job Description Clinical Lab Analyst (Overnight Shift) This is a great opportunity to join a high-complexity clinical laboratory that plays a critical role in newborn screening programs. In this position, you'll work with advanced laboratory technologies to help identify potentially life-threatening conditions in newborns, directly supporting positive patient outcomes. You'll perform testing on newborn blood spot specimens using a variety of techniques including immunoassay, enzyme assays, electrophoresis, HPLC, tandem mass spectrometry, and molecular methods. Responsibilities include operating and maintaining laboratory instrumentation, reviewing and documenting test results, performing quality control procedures, troubleshooting equipment and assay issues, and ensuring accurate, timely reporting of results. The lab operates 24/7, providing excellent hands-on experience with sophisticated instrumentation and high-throughput testing workflows. Analysts rotate through multiple testing areas, offering broad technical exposure and opportunities to expand their skill set through ongoing training and cross-training. What makes this role stand out: Hands-on experience with advanced clinical laboratory technologies Opportunity to support meaningful newborn screening programs Strong focus on quality assurance, data analysis, and continuous improvement Exposure to molecular testing, mass spectrometry, HPLC, and other specialized methodologies Collaborative team environment with extensive learning and growth opportunities Schedule: Overnight shift: 9:30 PM to 7:30 AM Rotating 5 days on, 4 days off schedule Includes weekends and holidays Initial training is typically completed on a daytime schedule before transitioning to nights This role is ideal for candidates with a Biology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Genetics, or related scientific background who are looking to build a career in clinical laboratory science and gain experience working in a regulated, high-complexity testing environment. Job Type & Location This is a Contract to Hire position based out of Ankeny, IA. Pay and Benefits The pay range for this position is $20.00 - $20.00/hr. As a Clinical Lab Analyst , you will perform specialized testing on newborn blood spot specimens using advanced laboratory technologies that help identify potentially life-threatening conditions in newborns. This role offers hands-on experience with sophisticated clinical laboratory instrumentation and methodologies while working in a collaborative environment focused on quality, accuracy, and continuous improvement. It is an excellent opportunity for candidates seeking to build a career in clinical laboratory science and gain experience within a regulated, high-complexity testing environment. Familiarity with quality control, quality assurance, and laboratory documentation practices. Experience working with laboratory instrumentation and data analysis software. Job Title: Supply Chain Analyst Job Description The Supply Chain Analyst will play a central role in a small, stable supply chain function, taking on the majority of day‑to‑day supply chain activities and enabling a senior consultant to focus on corporate governance and legal responsibilities. This is a broad, operational role covering contractor and contract management, inventory management, procurement, and bidding, with limited involvement in logistics. It is well suited to someone who enjoys hands‑on operational work, values stability, and is comfortable in a lean, flat organizational structure with modest upward mobility. Responsibilities Manage a broad range of operational supply chain activities, including inventory management, contracts, procurement, and bidding processes. Administer and maintain operational contracts, with a particular focus on Master Service Agreements (MSAs) and related contractor arrangements. Support contractor and contract management activities, ensuring agreements are up to date, compliant, and aligned with operational needs. Coordinate procurement activities, including sourcing, evaluating bids, and selecting suppliers in accordance with internal guidelines. Monitor inventory levels and support inventory management processes to ensure materials and equipment are available for operational needs. Collaborate with various operational departments within a production environment to understand their supply chain requirements and priorities. Perform administrative tasks related to supply chain operations, recognizing that the role is primarily operational rather than focused on large, strategic procurement deals. Work closely with the existing supply chain consultant to assume approximately 80% of current supply chain duties and ensure continuity of processes. Contribute to the ongoing build‑out of the supply chain function within a small team, helping to improve processes while remaining flexible and hands‑on. Operate effectively within a lean department of approximately one to one‑and‑a‑half full‑time supply chain staff, taking ownership of day‑to‑day responsibilities. Essential Skills 3–5 years of experience in a supply chain role Demonstrated experience across a broad range of supply chain functions, including inventory management, contracts, procurement, and bidding. Hands‑on experience working with Master Service Agreements (MSAs) in an operational supply chain context rather than solely on project‑based contracts. Experience in the oil and gas industry, with a basic understanding of how operational departments function within a production company. Comfort with a role that offers limited upward mobility and has a strong administrative and operational focus, without expectation of leading large, strategic procurement deals.
